name: Pleasing The Lord
overview: Pleasing the Lord involves living a life separated from ungodly influences and evil, as the blessed man avoids the counsel and company of sinners (Psalms 1:1; Proverbs 3:7). God is pleased when our ways align with His will, bringing even adversaries into peace (Proverbs 16:7). True sanctification comes through God's truth revealed in His Word (John 17:17), and those who live according to the flesh cannot please God (Romans 8:8). Ultimately, seeking to please God rather than men is essential to being a faithful servant of Christ (Galatians 1:10).
